title: Fane at SemEval-2025 Task 10: Zero-Shot Entity Framing with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the NLP task of entity framing classification within news articles. Although the framing labels include terms with moral connotations (e.g., Virtuous, Corrupt, Martyr), the study is a performance evaluation of LLMs on a linguistic classification benchmark (SemEval-2025 Task 10) and does not specifically evaluate religious beliefs, ethical frameworks, or the internal moral reasoning of the models.
